module_summary: Clock-crossing valid/ready handshake for isochronous clocks: toggling request and acknowledge flops in each domain are cross-registered, and their (in)equality yields src_ready and dst_valid.

anchors.name: src_req_q
anchors.why: Source-domain request toggle flipped on each accepted source transfer

anchors.name: dst_ack_q
anchors.why: Destination-domain acknowledge toggle flipped on each accepted destination transfer

anchors.name: dst_req_q
anchors.why: Request toggle registered into destination clock domain

anchors.name: src_ack_q
anchors.why: Acknowledge toggle registered into source clock domain

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid; with ready toggles src_req_q

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Source ready when request and synchronized acknowledge match

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination valid while synchronized request differs from acknowledge

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Destination ready; with valid toggles dst_ack_q

groups.name: Source domain handshake
groups.description: Request toggle and synchronized acknowledge producing src_ready_o

groups.name: Destination domain handshake
groups.description: Acknowledge toggle and synchronized request producing dst_valid_o
